subject: [PATCH v2 00/18] iomap: convert to in-iter iomap_next() model

2026-07-06.patch_summary: This patch series converts the iomap code to use an iterator model, replacing the legacy ->iomap_begin() and ->iomap_end() interface. The conversion is mechanical, with no functional changes intended. The new ->iomap_next() interface allows filesystems to provide direct begin/end helper functions, which are then used by the iomap_process() inline helper. The patches also update the documentation to reflect the new iterator model.
